question: Should this temporary workflow be run and retained long enough to diagnose the release-creation 403 despite its ability to create and delete draft releases?
rationale: The diagnostic is intentionally side-effectful and repository-owner judgment is needed to balance its debugging value against temporary release-write access.

options.title: Run once, then remove
options.body: Dispatch the probe for the diagnosis, save redacted results, and remove the workflow immediately afterward.

options.title: Reproduce outside Actions
options.body: Investigate the API behavior with an external controlled token instead of retaining a repository workflow with release-write access.

recommendation.title: Run once, then remove
recommendation.body: Dispatch the probe for the diagnosis, save redacted results, and remove the workflow immediately afterward.
